svg.title: The later rescaling from active chart variables to fluctuation variables is likewise exact. Let g > 0 be the coupling scale, p the real number of active coordinates, and separate fluctuation coordinates into active and vacant parts. The active affine dilation used in the source sends gp times Lebesgue measure to active-chart Lebesgue measure. Its coordinate reassembly is a permutation and preserves measure. The integrand depends on the active part through the original chart expression; the vacant part contributes a separate normalized Gaussian comfort factor with integral one. Thus, in these coordinates, its integral factors as Z Z Z Y (x)gpC(y)dxdy = gp Y (x)dx, C(y)dy = 1.
